tei:div.tei:p: da lan 'dir pha dam pa sangs rgyas dang*/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor sogs zhi byed dang shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi gsung kha shas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs yod/ las gzhi 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang zhus dag go rim legs sgrig gi skor las ma dpe dag ni a ri'i nang bstan dpe tshogs kyi dpe mdzod las byung ba zhig yin la/ zhus dag thad tshig 'bru mi gsal ba dang*/ rtsa chad song rigs gzhan yang ma dpe'i skung yig rnams 'ol tshod kyi kha ma bskangs par gzhung gong 'og dang*/ 'brel yod kyi gzhung gzhan dang 'bras spungs dgon sogs nas rnyed pa rnams dang zhib bsdur thog 'phyugs med du bkral pa dang*/ phrad sbyor yig nor mngon gsal dag bcos pa phud/ ma dpe'i nang don la bcos lhad byas med cing*/ chos tshan gyi go rim ni dus rabs snga phyi ltar bzhag yod/ brjod bya gtso bo'i gzhung don tshan pa dang po dam pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung rnams ni 'phags yul gyi gru thob pho mo dang*/ rnal 'byor pho mo brgya lhag tsam gyi gdams pa rnams bsdus te bla ma byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' sogs la ngo sprod du gsungs pa dang*/ ding ri brgyad cu pa sogs kyis ni ding ri ba rnams bzhag pa'i gnas skabs mthar thug gi legs lam la ji ltar bya tshul du bzhag pa'i zhal chems dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la ras pa la gdams pa'i mgur las ni dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi snying po dril zhing gsungs pa zhig tu 'dug cing*/ tshan pa gnyis pa ma cig gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gcod kyi gzhung shes rab skra rtse'i sa gzhung spel ba rin po che'i gter mdzod dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag yang tshom zhus lan ma sogs kyis ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i zab don dang*/ de nyams su len skabs su bdud las ji ltar spang tshul rnams zhib cing phra ba gsungs yod/

tshan pa gsum pa mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyi gsung las ni bka' brgyud rin chen phreng ba rim par byon pa rnams kyis 'khor ba la zhen log nges 'byung gi skul lcag 'debs pa dang*/ dam pa chos kyi nyams myong gong nas gong du spel ba dang*/ rtogs pa'i ye shes la dpa' tshan skyed pa dang*/ dpa' bo ḍā ki rnams dgyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba mtha' yas pa chos kyi sbyin pa bla na med pas tshim par bya ba'i slad du dgongs pa zab mo'i nyams skyug do ha rdo rje'i dbyangs kyi gad mo mkha' khyab tu sgrog pa rnams bsdus te gsungs pa zhig tu snang ngo/ / dpe tshogs 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang dpe sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa 'gro 'dul rdo rje dang*/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/ thub bstan nyi ma/ karma bde legs bcas dang*/ rtsis 'khor du phab pa'i 'gan khur ba zla ba dang*/ blo bzang chos 'phel gnyis/ zhus dag dang*/ sdeb bzo/ mdzes bkod sogs dpal brtsegs las zhor slob ma'i bgyis shing legs par grub pa'o/ / bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ - PAGE 2 -- PAGE 3 -- PAGE 1 -
